package.name: crusader_perception
package.description: Sensor-coupled processing: raw data in, detections out. Owns the OAK-D and ranges what it detects, so it needs both depthai and TensorRT - it runs in the `asv` container with the rest of the stack. Holds `oakd_publisher` (RGB + depth aligned and paired on-device) and `buoy_detector` (detections in camera_link). See the package README.
